Cornrows Appointments Near Oakland, CA

What are cornrows? Cornrows are a style of multiple braids made close to the scalp and formed in rows of various widths. The defining underhand technique creates raised braids that also expose sections of the scalp.

Why book cornrows with StyleSeat?
